note: Unselected T2D; scored members are dulaglutide, semaglutide and danuglipron (exenatide and liraglutide are not members of this tile).
label: Type 2 diabetes (GLP-1R agonists)

engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading; model_first_use_year is the publication proxy.
engagement.note: Dulaglutide raised glucose-dependent insulin secretion in monkeys for up to a week after one dose; no human data yet.
engagement.short: Monkey insulin up for a week
engagement.quote: In monkeys, LY2189265 significantly increased glucose-dependent insulin secretion for up to a week after one dose, retained efficacy when administered subchronically (once weekly for 4 weeks) and was well tolerated.

engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading of both papers; pairing is the drafter's.
engagement.note: Single doses in healthy volunteers raised glucose-dependent insulin secretion and blunted OGTT glucose at all doses, as in monkeys.
engagement.quote: Evidence of increase in glucose-dependent insulin secretion and suppression of serum glucose excursions were observed during an OGTT at all doses compared to placebo; no episodes of hypoglycaemia occurred.
engagement.judgement: Insulin secretion is downstream of receptor cAMP; no member has a direct occupancy readout. Healthy-volunteer data count for engagement. Paired by the drafter (same sponsor, no side-by-side statement).

dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level. Candidate selection predates the 2015 paper; the year is the publication proxy.
dose.note: Semaglutide chosen as the once-weekly candidate on a 46 h i.v. half-life in minipigs.
dose.quote: The plasma half-life was 46.1 h in mini-pigs following i.v. administration, and semaglutide has an MRT of 63.6 h after s.c. dosing to mini-pigs.

dose.magnitude_basis: elimination half-life, human ~168 h vs minipig 46 h (3.6x longer in humans)
dose.note: Human half-life about one week; once-weekly 0.5-1 mg met the HbA1c endpoint in SUSTAIN 1, so the regimen target was reached and enough.
dose.quote: With an elimination half-life of approximately 1 week, semaglutide will be present in the circulation for about 5 weeks after the last dose.
dose.judgement: The model's target was a once-weekly regimen; the half-life was underpredicted 3.6x in the conservative direction, so the regimen held and is scored same, with the miss recorded in magnitude. FDA pharmacology review (209637) states minipig pharmacology was filed.

dose.note: Half-life 1.5-2 days in rats and monkeys; sponsor proposed once-weekly dosing on these data.
dose.quote: Half-life in rats and cynomolgus monkeys was 1.5-2 days, and serum immunoreactivity representing active compound persisted > 6 days.

dose.magnitude_basis: elimination half-life, human ~90 h vs rat/monkey 36-48 h (1.9-2.5x)
dose.note: Human half-life ~90 h supported once-weekly dosing; weekly doses >=1 mg lowered glucose and HbA1c in T2D (EGO, 5-week study).
dose.quote: LY showed an acceptable safety profile and exhibited the expected glucagon-like peptide-1 pharmacological effects on glucose suppression and insulin secretion with a half-life that supports once-weekly dosing.
dose.judgement: Half-life ratio straddles 2x (1.9-2.5x); recorded as off_by_2-5x. The regimen prediction held and patients were dosed to it with efficacy, so same rather than contra.

dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level; model_first_use_year from the 2020 bioRxiv of Griffith et al (doi:10.1021/acs.jmedchem.1c01856).
dose.note: Danuglipron does not act on rodent GLP-1R (primate Trp33); a humanized-receptor mouse showed efficacy comparable to injectable peptides.
dose.quote: We developed danuglipron (PF-06882961), an oral small-molecule GLP-1R agonist and found it had comparable efficacy to injectable peptidic GLP-1R agonists in a humanized mouse model.

dose.magnitude_basis: glycaemic efficacy relative to injectable peptides
dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level. Year is the NCT03985293 results posting (2022-06-30), earlier than the 2023 paper. Quote is a clause of a longer sentence.
dose.note: Oral 120 mg b.i.d. cut HbA1c 1.16% vs placebo at 16 weeks, near the injectable range the mouse predicted.
dose.quote: For all danuglipron doses, HbA1c and FPG were statistically significantly reduced at week 16 vs placebo, with HbA1c reductions up to a least squares mean difference vs placebo of -1.16% (90% CI, -1.47% to -0.86%) for the 120-mg twice daily group
dose.judgement: No numeric exposure target from the mouse could be found at abstract level, so magnitude is direction_only. The 2025 discontinuation (liver injury, obesity programme) is a safety question, not dose, and was not scored (no model source on hepatic silence found).

efficacy.note: One dose improved glucose tolerance in diabetic mice; twice-weekly dosing for 4 weeks delayed hyperglycaemia and lowered weight.
efficacy.quote: LY2189265 increased glucose tolerance in diabetic mice after one dose and lowered weight and delayed hyperglycaemia when administered twice weekly for 4 weeks.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: HbA1c change (mice: glucose tolerance, no HbA1c)
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level. EGO's NCT number is not in the abstract; registry_date not found.
efficacy.note: EGO phase 2: once-weekly dulaglutide cut HbA1c 1.3-1.6% vs 0.24% placebo at 16 weeks; later semaglutide and danuglipron matched too.
efficacy.quote: At week 16, A1c changes (least-squares mean ± standard error) were -0.24 ± 0.12, -1.38 ± 0.12, -1.32 ± 0.12 and -1.59 ± 0.12%, in the placebo, LY 0.5/1.0, LY 1.0/1.0 and LY 1.0/2.0 arms, respectively (all p < 0.001 vs. placebo).
efficacy.reason: HbA1c fell in every member tested

patient_trials.quote: Mean baseline HbA1c was 8·05% (SD 0·85); at week 30, HbA1c significantly decreased by 1·45% (95% CI -1·65 to -1·26) with 0·5 mg semaglutide
For all danuglipron doses, HbA1c and FPG were statistically significantly reduced at week 16 vs placebo

efficacy.judgement: Same, not neg: no member with model data is known to have missed its HbA1c primary endpoint (dulaglutide, semaglutide SUSTAIN 1, danuglipron phase 2b all positive). Outcome trial positive: SUSTAIN-6 (Marso 2016, doi:10.1056/NEJMoa1607141) cut MACE with semaglutide. Discontinued members (LY2428757, TTP054, TTP273, CJC-1134-PC, YH14617) were not checked for HbA1c failures within budget.

safety.confidence_note: On-target harm, pooled across modalities. Semaglutide's 2017 review reports the same at 0.4x clinical AUC in rats.
safety.note: Dulaglutide raised thyroid C-cell adenomas in 2-year rats at >=7x clinical AUC; FDA boxed warning, human relevance unknown.
safety.quote: In Sprague-Dawley rats, 2 years of twice weekly treatment resulted in an increase in the incidence of thyroid C-cell adenomas at >0.5 mg/kg (≥7X clinical AUC).

safety.magnitude_basis: thyroid cancer hazard ratio vs DPP4 inhibitors
safety.confidence_note: Abstract-level. The cohort pools all GLP-1 RAs; the member (semaglutide, dulaglutide) share could not be read. Mean follow-up 3.9 years; MTC HR 1.19 (0.37-3.86) is uninformative.
safety.note: 145,410 GLP-1 RA users, 2007-21: no thyroid-cancer excess (HR 0.93); the rodent C-cell tumour prediction has not appeared in patients.
safety.quote: GLP1 receptor agonist use was not associated with increased risk of thyroid cancer (hazard ratio 0.93, 95% confidence interval 0.66 to 1.31; rate difference -0.13, 95% confidence interval -0.61 to 0.36 events per 10 000 person years).
safety.reason: Rodent C-cell tumours absent in patients
safety.judgement: Predicted harm not seen in patients scored contra/opposite per the brief. Alternative reading: untested, since MTC is rare and slow and the cohort is dominated by non-member liraglutide. Dissent exists (Bezin 2023, French case-control, not re-verified). Danuglipron's 2025 liver injury (obesity programme, tier 5) was not entered: no model source stating hepatic silence was found.
